eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Oregon; at 11:19 AM on AUG 31, 2026 Effective until 12:19 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Josephine County has requested activation of an AMBER Alert for Kaydence Patterson. The victim was taken from 32429 Redwood Highway overnight on 08-31-2026. The suspect was driving a 2006, Silver Infinity M 30, license plate, O E O 4 2 2, Oregon, unknown direction of travel. The suspect has been identified as James Patterson. Suspect is described as 5 feet 10 inches with a thin build, brown hair, unknown clothing description. The victim is 8 months old. If you have any information about this incident, please contact the Oregon AMBER Alert Tip Line at 1 8 6 6 5 AMBER 5 1 8 6 6 5 2 6 2 3 7 5 or call 9 1 1.
